lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: On an isolated Debug emulator run BackgroundLocationWarningTest with location/account grants and enabled location; do not run on a physical phone.
Verify launch without recording warns for screen-off GPS Battery Saver, app background restriction and missing Doze exemption, even with the legacy prompt hidden.
Verify each single Settings action opens the relevant system request or page directly without an app choice dialog; rotation retains acknowledgement and Resume detects a new restriction.
Enable GPS Battery Saver and remove Doze exemption together; verify the choice dialog offers both settings and the selected battery optimization action opens its system request.
While the app UID is background-restricted, return from the foreground test helper with system Back and await RESUMED; do not rely on the restricted UID's implicit AndroidX resume broadcast.
value.expected: Warning does not block the map or start a track/walk; unchanged acknowledged state does not repeat, new restriction warns and clearing restrictions dismisses it. OEM field smoke remains separate.
